Answer: C
Reason: Comparing the 2003 and 2007 chest X-rays, there is a noticeable progression of fibrotic changes and increased pleural thickening/apical capping in the upper lobes. In patients with advanced sarcoidosis and fibrocystic disease, this structural distortion predisposes them to colonization by Aspergillus, leading to the development of an aspergillus mycetoma (fungus ball) within the cavities or thickened areas.
